approach: spec only: two new behavioral leaves under a new eval-run/bench/ index plus the fit governance; no implementation
the engine is wrong-squad, so its suite is boolean and node:test-verifiable; the skill is partial and ACED-graded
the regression verdict combines direction, significance, and the cost exclusion, so its rule is stated in closed form before any scenario
no frozen suite is touched; compare and report wiring are follow-ups on their own nodes
the spec gate is the owner's: open the PR in draft and do not freeze or ratify
blast: medium — adds a new eval layer and a record schema a downstream consumer (agent-readiness) will read, plus a second axis on the fit governance every ACED node is classified under. Bounded: the axis is opt-in, so no existing node changes classification.
novelty: medium — the engine is a port of a working tool; the new moves are the subject kinds, the cost exclusion from the gate, and the second fit axis.
floor: none — no frozen .feature is edited; new nodes only.
